label: increment
definition: Work that meets the definition of done and is merged on the base branch, usable as it stands. Each merged PR adds one; a sprint's increments are what the sprint review inspects.
is_not: A PR: an open PR is not done; it becomes an increment when it merges with the gate green.
A release: a release ships increments to users; an increment exists on the base branch before any release.
A commit: a commit on a feature branch has not met the definition of done.
